description:
Cross Platform Xray-core Client

OneXray is a cross-platform Xray-core client for managing proxy configurations and VPN/TUN connections.
OneXray v26.8.3 adds secure subscription delivery, portable OneXray Links,
and expanded runtime settings, with fixes for Android VPN startup and Chinese
language display.
What's Changed
- Added optional age-encrypted subscriptions with X25519 and Mihomo-compatible
  Hybrid (ML-KEM-768 + X25519) key generation.
- Added onexray:// import and sharing for Outbound nodes, Xray Profiles,
  Full Configs, Raw Json, subscriptions, and GeoData.
- Added System and OneXray User-Agent options for subscription and GeoData
  downloads.
- Added advanced Apple network routing controls for includeAllNetworks and
  the related exclude policies.
- Updated Backup to v4 so age subscription key pairs can be restored. Backup
  ZIP files remain unencrypted and should be stored securely.
- Improved runtime config handling, subscription updates, and batch ping.
Fixes
- Fixed the first Android VPN connection failing after the system permission
  dialog (#136).
- Improved Simplified Chinese locale handling and Windows Chinese font
  fallback.
- Improved imported-config ping scheduling and VPN state handling during
  startup and reconnection.
Upgrade Note
After updating on iOS or macOS, open OneXray and reconnect once so the saved
VPN configuration uses the new runtime request format. Legacy VPN startup
snapshots are not supported.
New Contributors
- @ts0307 made their first contribution in
  #136.
